task: fixed-horizon high-probability terminal prediction risk for stationary binary renewal sources
status: INTERNALLY_PROVED_CANDIDATE; EXTERNAL REVIEW AND NOVELTY UNKNOWN

interface.data: one raw stationary binary trajectory X_1^n
interface.source_class: iid positive-integer renewal gaps with arbitrary finite mean
interface.predictor_information: all n observed bits, no source parameter
interface.confidence_claim_scope: fixed n only; hard prior depends on n

risk_objects.random_conditional_risk: R_n(mu,X^n)=KL(P_mu(X_{n+1}|X^n)||qhat_n(.|X^n)); randomness is through the observed training/context path
risk_objects.expected_conditional_risk: E_{X^n} R_n(mu,X^n); existing type-first upper bound
risk_objects.realized_log_score: Lambda_n=log(P_mu(X_{n+1}|X^n)/qhat_n(X_{n+1}|X^n)); its conditional mean given X^n is R_n
risk_objects.independent_history_risk: evaluates a trained rule on a separate stationary X'^n; not covered
